description: The Kestrel Aero hangar at sunset: a narrow-body jet with its door open, yellow access stairs and tool carts on a polished floor.
Close on a main landing gear in the hangar: two tires, the strut and the open wheel well, a tool cart beside it.
The maintenance office off the hangar: blueprints on the wall, manuals, a workbench with a part and a laptop, the jet through the window.
